properties.outage_description:
10:26 - Receive no lights call from 8391 Manhasset St. Dispatch E120 to investigate.

11:45 - E120 reports failed U/G Transformer C7093. Need Crew to replace.

NGUYEN on shift.
WO 2709025 - Replace Failed C7093

15:04 - OC-1531 + 1532: NRA's in effect.
15:04 - OC T-1 + T-2 LTC's: Blocked + Volts Matched.
15:38 - X7100, Phase 2 Standoff Elbow broke from mooring.
16:10 - X7100, Phase 2 Standoff Elbow repaired.
16:13 - X7100, 3 Phase Elbows: Phase + CLOSE, tying OC-1531 + 1532.
16:42 - C7091, 3 Phase Elbows: OPEN, breaking OC-1531 + 1532 Tie. (C7091 has inadequate tags on elbows.  Crew troubleshoot + apply Tags on Elbows in structure.)
17:42 - C7098, 3 Phase Elbows: OPEN, isolating to C7093
17:42 - B7094, Phase 1 Elbow: OPEN, isolating to C7093.

17:42 - DOMINGUEZ has Clearance on C7093 b/w OPEN 3 Phase Elbows in C7091 + C7098 and Phase 1 Elbow in B7094. 

 17:48 - OC T-1 + T-2 LTC's: Un-Blocked.

 - DOMINGUEZ releases Clearance on C7093 b/w OPEN 3 Phase Elbows in C7091 + C7098 and Phase 1 Elbow in B7094. All personal shorts and grounds have been removed and the equipment is ready to be energized.  All personnel are in the clear.  

 - B7094, Phase 1 Elbow: CLOSE, returning to normal.
 - C7098, 3 Phase Elbows: CLOSE, energizing C7093.  All load up.
 - OC T-1 + T-2 LTC's: Blocked + Volts Matched. 
 - C7091, 3 Phase Elbows: Phase + CLOSE, Tying OC-1531 + 1532. 
 - X7100, 3 Phase Elbows: OPEN, breaking OC-1531 + 1532 Tie.
 - OC T-1 + T-2 LTC's: Un-Blocked.
 - OC-1531 + 1532: NRA's released.
